title: [FEATURE] Add disableCaffeinate for use on OSX for Orgs that block it's usage
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

I work at an Org that disables `caffeinate` on OSX.  Can you introduce an option to disable it from being called by Claude Code entirely.  Would save a lot on headaches.

### Proposed Solution

Add a setting somewhere like:
`disableCaffeinate: true`

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

Medium - Would be very helpful

### Feature Category

Configuration and settings

### Use Case Example

_No response_

### Additional Context

_No response_
author: jonathanhle

top_comments.author: gurghet
top_comments.body: It should be opt-in, not opt-out. caffeinate is some extreme way to make something work. my batteries were drained unexpectedly. it can also damage your mac. please be responsible.

top_comments.author: github-actions[bot]
top_comments.body: Closing for now — inactive for too long. Please [open a new issue](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/new/choose) if this is still relevant.
